params.body:
## What

The landing repo was a July port of the old WordPress site plus the August redesign; the copy still described the app of 2022 and held placeholder testimonials and a "free until end of 2022" promotion. This PR brings the current content of https://stocklistdealer.eu over, rewrites what is outdated to the app as it runs since the 2026-09-15 cutover, and lists the screenshots that still have to be taken.

## Audit (committed, source of truth for the port)

- `docs/content-audit/2026-09-16/{nl,en,fr}/*.md`: raw extraction of all 10 live URLs per language (headings, copy, lists, CTAs, images with alt, testimonials, form fields, footer).
- `docs/content-audit/2026-09-16/gap-report.md`: per page what was ported, what is outdated, what must not be ported, and nine decisions for Shane (video, stats, pricing, trader offer, the 21-days claim, socials, privacy address/email, footer credit, translated testimonials).
- `docs/content-audit/2026-09-16/screenshot-shotlist.md`: 21 screenshots with page, section, what must be on it, viewport and the expected file under `public/img/screens/`.

## Content (all three languages)

- Home: the three real testimonials (Bart Peelaerts, Sophie Gilte, Garage Snauwaert) replace "Naam volgt"; the eight feature cards and the stock-module block describe the current app (VIN lookup, two photo sets, publish switch, Car-Pass in one click, bidding follow-up, transport paid through Mollie, quotations with RealGarant and Flexlease, iframe with language picker or public API); the two audience columns link to `/garagisten/` and `/handelaars/`.
- `/garagisten/`: from an empty page to the dealer page: benefits, three steps, thirteen features (ten with the 2022 screenshots kept in place, three empty slots), CTA, form. Added to the navigation.
- `/handelaars/`: rewritten on the seven-day silent bidding flow; the 2022 promotion is gone; the one-column comparison table is a plain list.
- `/privacy/`: the live page is an unfilled template ("BEDRIJFSNAAM", a paragraph about funeral photos); it is now a noindex pointer to the privacy statement, the cookie statement (PDF) and the platform conditions 2025 (PDF). The footer links to those PDFs, carried over under the same `/media` paths.
- No numbers invented: stats, trust bar and prices stay as TODO in signal green; nothing else carries a figure the app does not itself fix (7 days, 6 months, 18 damage locations).

## Code

- `types.ts` / `Sections.astro`: `features.items[].image` is optional; a missing screenshot renders as a framed "screenshot volgt" in signal green (same convention as the TODO figures), plus `anchor` and `pendingLabel` on `features`. No new section type.
- `icons.ts`: seven extra line icons for the new cards.
- `i18n.ts`, `site.ts`, `Footer.astro`: footer links to the PDFs, Garagisten in the nav.

## Checks

`npm ci`, `npm run check` (0 errors, 0 warnings) and `npm run build` (31 pages) pass.
params.title: Landing: current stocklistdealer.eu content, and a shot list for the new app
